name: Tanaka Kousuke
source:
A man who works for the Matsue City Council Complaints Department. [spoiler]He refuses to talk about Aya Fumino, but his real identity appears to be the “Megane” (Four-Eyes) friend Aya wrote about in her letters. Although said to be the school’s utmost prodigy at the time, his grades began to fall after the summer of senior year in high school, and he didn’t make it into his university of choice. But he graduated from a nameless college, and although he holds down a steady job at City Hall, does not enjoy his life.[/spoiler] His favorite phrase is “~desu yo ne” (“isn’t it?”). He has a bit of a stutter and a polite tone when he speaks, but no confidence in himself. And he is not yet freed from the spell he fell under 15 years ago.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2015/11/root-letter-introduces-actress-aya-game-system]Gematsu[/url]]
